ei.title: Why Experts Struggle to Teach Novices
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: A number of research studies have shown how experts in a field often experience difficulties when introducing newcomers to that field. For example, in a genuine training situation, Dr Pamela Hinds found that people expert in using mobile phones were remarkably less accurate than novice phone users in judging how long it takes people to learn to use the phones. Experts can become insensitive to how hard a task is for the beginner, an effect referred to as the 'curse of knowledge'. Dr Hinds was able to show that as people acquired the skill, they then began to underestimate the level of difficulty of that skill. Her participants even underestimated how long it had taken themselves to acquire that skill in an earlier session. Knowing that experts forget how hard it was for them to learn, we can understand the need to look at the learning process through students' eyes, rather than making assumptions about how students 'should be' learning.

questions.passage: A number of research studies have shown how experts in a field often experience difficulties when ①<u>introducing</u> newcomers to that field. For example, in a genuine training situation, Dr Pamela Hinds found that people expert in using mobile phones were remarkably less accurate than novice phone users in judging how long it takes people ②<u>to learn</u> to use the phones. Experts can become insensitive to how hard a task is for the beginner, an effect ③<u>referring</u> to as the 'curse of knowledge'. Dr Hinds was able to show that as people ④<u>acquired</u> the skill, they then began to underestimate the level of difficulty of that skill. Her participants even underestimated how long it had taken themselves to acquire that skill in an earlier session. Knowing that experts forget how hard it was for them to learn, we can understand the need to look at the learning process through students' eyes, rather than making assumptions about how students 'should be' learning.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ referring → referred: effect를 수식하는 과거분사(수동)
det.analysis:
❌ ① introducing: 'when introducing newcomers' — 분사구문 — 어법 적절

❌ ② to learn: 'how long it takes people to learn' — to부정사 — 어법 적절

✅ ③ referring → referred: 'an effect referred to as the curse of knowledge'에서 effect는 '일컬어지는' 대상이므로 과거분사 referred가 맞음. referring(능동)은 오류 ← 정답

❌ ④ acquired: 'as people acquired the skill' — 과거시제 — 어법 적절
det.tip: be referred to as = ~로 일컬어지다. 수동이므로 과거분사 referred

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① how hard is a task → how hard a task is: 간접의문문은 '의문사+주어+동사' 어순
det.analysis:
✅ ① how hard is a task → how hard a task is: 'insensitive to how hard a task is'는 간접의문문이므로 '의문사(how hard)+주어(a task)+동사(is)' 어순이어야 함. 의문문 어순(is a task)은 오류 ← 정답

❌ ② underestimate: 'began to underestimate' — to부정사 — 어법 적절

❌ ③ themselves: 'it had taken themselves'에서 재귀대명사 — 어법 적절

❌ ④ to look: 'the need to look at' — 명사 수식 to부정사 — 어법 적절
det.tip: 간접의문문 어순: how hard + a task(주어) + is(동사)

questions.passage: A number of research studies have shown how experts in a field often experience difficulties when introducing newcomers to that field. For example, in a genuine training situation, Dr Pamela Hinds found that people expert in using mobile phones were remarkably less accurate than novice phone users in judging how long it takes people to learn to use the phones. Experts can become insensitive to how hard a task is for the beginner, an effect referred to as the 'curse of knowledge'. Dr Hinds was able to show that as people acquired the skill, they then began to underestimate the level of difficulty of that skill. Her participants even underestimated how long it had taken <u>themselves</u> to acquire that skill in an earlier session. Knowing that experts forget how hard it was for them to learn, we can understand the need to look at the learning process through students' eyes, rather than making assumptions about how students 'should be' learning.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 themselves가 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: themselves = 참가자들
det.analysis:
❌ ① 초보 사용자: themselves는 과소평가를 한 참가자 자신

✅ ② 실험에 참가한 사람들(참가자들): 'Her participants even underestimated how long it had taken themselves' — themselves는 앞의 participants(참가자들) 자신 ← 정답

❌ ③ Dr Hinds와 연구진: 실험을 수행한 쪽이지 themselves의 대상이 아님

❌ ④ 강사들: 본문에 그런 대상 없음
det.tip: participants ... themselves = 참가자들 자신

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸: acquire that skill in an earlier session(이전 세션에서 그 기술을 습득하다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① teach that skill to other experts(다른 전문가에게 가르치다): 본문 근거 없음

❌ ② forget that skill completely over time(완전히 잊다): 본문 근거 없음

✅ ③ acquire that skill in an earlier session(이전 세션에서 그 기술을 습득하다): 참가자들이 이전 세션에서 기술을 익히는 데 걸린 시간을 과소평가했다 ← 정답

❌ ④ describe that skill to a researcher(연구자에게 설명하다): 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: how long it had taken themselves to ____ → 이전 세션에서 기술 습득
